_help: Devil Fruits found in Rare Chests. Every fruit exists once per run: once a Nakama eats it, it leaves the chest pool. Each Nakama can eat only one. atk and hp are multipliers applied permanently to the Nakama that eats it. desc is optional; when missing it is generated from atk and hp. Text fields accept a plain string or {"en":"...","es":"..."}. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

_fruit_fields.name: string or {en,es}
_fruit_fields.type: logia | paramecia | zoan | ancientZoan | mythicalZoan (any other text is shown as is)
_fruit_fields.color: hex color of the fruit orb
_fruit_fields.weight: relative chance of appearing in a chest (default 1)

desc.en: Grants the power to create, control and become fire.
desc.es: Otorga el poder de crear, controlar y convertirse en fuego.

desc.en: Grants a rubber-like body with extraordinary elasticity.
desc.es: Otorga un cuerpo de goma con una elasticidad extraordinaria.

desc.en: Grants the power to create, control and become sand.
desc.es: Otorga el poder de crear, controlar y convertirse en arena.

desc.en: Allows the user to sprout copies of their body parts anywhere within range.
desc.es: Permite al usuario hacer brotar copias de partes de su cuerpo dentro de un área determinada.

desc.en: Allows the user to split their body into separate pieces.
desc.es: Permite al usuario separar su cuerpo en distintas partes.

desc.en: Grants the power to create, control and become lightning.
desc.es: Otorga el poder de crear, controlar y convertirse en electricidad.

desc.en: Grants the power to create and control darkness and gravity-like attraction.
desc.es: Otorga el poder de crear y controlar oscuridad y una atracción similar a la gravedad.

desc.en: Grants the power to create, control and become light.
desc.es: Otorga el poder de crear, controlar y convertirse en luz.

desc.en: Grants the power to create, control and become magma.
desc.es: Otorga el poder de crear, controlar y convertirse en magma.

desc.en: Allows the user to manipulate everything within a special spherical operating room.
desc.es: Permite manipular todo lo que se encuentra dentro de una sala de operaciones esférica.

desc.en: Allows the user to create and control extremely strong strings.
desc.es: Permite crear y controlar hilos extremadamente resistentes.

desc.en: A Mythical Zoan granting the powers of the legendary Sun God Nika.
desc.es: Una Zoan mitológica que otorga los poderes del legendario Dios del Sol Nika.

desc.en: Allows the user to transform into a phoenix and regenerate using blue flames.
desc.es: Permite transformarse en un fénix y regenerarse mediante llamas azules.

desc.es: Permite transformarse en el legendario Dragón Azul.

desc.es: Una fruta Zoan que otorga las capacidades de un humano.

desc.es: Permite transformarse en un leopardo o en un híbrido humano-leopardo.
